verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and connectivity platform, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows falls outside its product category. Nothing in the pack shows it shipping a scheduler. The nearby items are other things: webhooks, IaC automation, and the iOS Shortcuts integration, which is a host-platform feature. The time-boxed ACL reset in comm-4 is a customer-built Slack bot, a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
